query:
SELECT id, name, cas_number FROM molecules 
WHERE name IN ('Anéthole', 'Anethole', 'Méthyl-eugénol', 'Methyl eugenol', 'Estragole', 'Méthylchavicol')
   OR name LIKE '%néthole%' OR name LIKE '%Methyl%eugén%' OR name LIKE '%stragole%'
LIMIT 10;
